why: Artifacts pin the inputs they were computed from. A few historical inputs were already unrecoverable when this repository was consolidated. Each exception is matched on the exact original path and missing expected digest. Recoverable versions belong in provenance/frozen-code and remain byte-verified; a new missing digest or any corrupted archived blob fails the gate. Entries marked 'pre-consolidation revision' share one cause and one search, recorded 2026-08-19. Their experiments ran before the FORGE engine was consolidated into this tree, against a working tree carrying uncommitted edits, so the config recorded the hash of a file state that was never committed anywhere. Each was searched for by content in every blob of this repository (2,194 over 31 commits), every blob of the predecessor forge repository (2,226 over 245 commits), and every copy of the filename on the originating filesystem (153 copies). None matched, and each file already differed from its pinned digest at cc947f5, the first commit here. Every declaring config carries an explicit frozen_* status.
how_to_add: Do not add an entry to make a failing gate pass. An entry is only correct when the pinned bytes are genuinely unrecoverable AND the artifact that pinned them is frozen. If the input still exists somewhere, restore it instead.

known_drift.reason: The phase-1 split manifest was regenerated upstream after the prelaunch audit ran. The audit's own conclusions are frozen and the superseded manifest was never committed, so the pinned bytes are unrecoverable. Inherited from forge; unchanged across every commit in this repository.
